notes.title: v0.2 out!
notes.content:
Theres alot of unfinished stuff and crud but i figured i should push *something*. Sorry for long development time on this update and for honestly not a huge update either, we have been pretty busy with life and stuff lolll. also this isnt a april fools joke
New Stuff:

   [list]
[*]  new muzzle flash
[*]     new weapon: bow (pretty jank and unfinished)
[*]     new world: deep forest
[*]     new boss: big bear
[list]
[*]  only first phase is out
[/list]
[*]     new enemy: wolf pack (be warned, pretty op if they manage to hit you, its a qte so make sure to spam E if one of them tackle you)
[*]     new enemy: screecher
[*]     new enemy: shotgunner
[*]     new attachment: manic A.I.
[list]
[*] kills lower your current cooldown
[/list]
[*]     new attachment: tactical A.I.
[list]
[*] kills makes your next reload faster
[/list]
[*]     new skill: scrap shield
[list]
[*]  prevent damage 1 time per level
[/list]
[*]     new music for world 1 and bandit leader boss
[*]     new start screen
[*]     new character select screen (no new characters yet)
[*] 
[/list]
Changes/Balancing:

    [list]
[*] made hot bullets WAY hotter
[list]
[*]          also new hot bullets sprite
[/list]
[*]     crossbow can now only pierce enemies that have health less than half of the damage dealt
[/list]
      

Fixes:

[list]
[*]     YOU NO LONGER GET SOFTLOCKED IN WALLS RANDOMLY ON LEVEL START LETS GOOOOOO
[*]     honestly i lowkey forget but theres probably other bug fixes i made....
[/list]
